$comment: DT-44: the built-in redaction rules. A window, app or calendar title that matches one is stored as [redacted] (the app name and times stay). `titles` are regular expressions matched anywhere in the title, ignoring case; `apps` are pieces of an app name or app id (lowercase) whose titles are always redacted. The user can switch a rule off, or add their own words, from the Privacy page.
